articles.title: Attaching to a running subagent without losing the transcript
articles.focus: How v1.29.0's Ctrl+S subagent attach works under the hood - the Ink <Static> remount-per-agent trick that fixes the transcript-not-printing bug, how parallel subagent cycles are tracked, and what the new detach UX means for debugging multi-agent runs interactively.

articles.title: PrivacyContext - scrubbing prompts without breaking the conversation
articles.focus: The architecture of the new privacy-aware prompt scrubbing system - how sensitive content is detected and replaced with stable placeholders before leaving the machine, how tool arguments get rehydrated locally so the model still sees the values it needs, the /privacy command and rule-pack model, and what this release means for running cloud models on private codebases.
